name: app-web-3d
description: FORMA Studio: motor calculation/v1, cotizador único, CRM y flujo comercial; Beta 0.8 con modo nube (Firebase Auth + Firestore), respaldo manual y régimen tributario confirmado por el propietario.

scripts.e2e: python3 apps/beta-web/tests/browser_engine_flow.py && python3 apps/beta-web/tests/browser_quick_flow.py && python3 apps/beta-web/tests/browser_workflow.py && python3 apps/beta-web/tests/browser_draft_delete.py && python3 apps/beta-web/tests/browser_backup.py && python3 apps/beta-web/tests/browser_materials.py && python3 apps/beta-web/tests/browser_multicolor.py && python3 apps/beta-web/tests/browser_last_plate.py && python3 apps/beta-web/tests/browser_production_ui.py && python3 apps/beta-web/tests/browser_order_correction.py && python3 apps/beta-web/tests/browser_import_bambu.py && python3 apps/beta-web/tests/browser_today.py && python3 apps/beta-web/tests/browser_cloud_flow.py
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run arch && npm run lint:guard && npm run test && npm run lint && npm run depcruise && npm run test:beta
scripts.test:rules: firebase --config firebase.emulator.json emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-forma-rules "node --test tests/rules/firestore.rules.test.mjs"
